Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 25, 2026

Moetiv helps you find a car and — only if you ask — has Moe, our AI agent, contact a dealer for you. This page explains, in plain language, what we collect, who sees it, and how to get it deleted.

What we collect

When you search and save cars, Moetiv uses:

  • Your search preferences — budget, vehicle type, condition, features, ZIP code and distance.
  • The cars you save as favorites.

Only if you use the AI agent (Moe), we also collect what you type into that flow:

  • Your name and email address, and your phone number if you choose to add it (it’s optional).
  • Your deal terms — for example finance or cash, monthly target, money down, term, and maximum out-the-door price.
  • Your trade-in details — year, make and model, VIN, mileage, amount owed, condition notes, and any photos you upload.
  • Anything else you type into the agent, such as notes for the dealer.

Who we share it with

Your information goes to one place only: the dealer you pick, and only after you tick the consent box — “I authorize Moetiv to contact this dealer on my behalf” — and send the deal.

We do not sell your data. We do not share it with anyone else, and we do not run ads or trackers that sell your data.

What Moetiv does not do

  • We do not run your credit, and we never ask for your Social Security number or bank details — please don’t send them.
  • We do not give you a firm trade-in value. Only the dealer can appraise your trade.
  • We do not close your deal, sign anything for you, or move any money.

Where your data lives

Your favorites and any deal packet you’re still working on stay on your own phone — they are not sent anywhere. If you choose to send a deal, the packet is emailed to the dealer through the Moetiv server, with a copy (CC) to you, so you can see exactly what was sent.

How long we keep it, and how to delete it

Data on your phone stays there until you clear it. To ask us to delete data from a deal you sent, email privacy@motiv.app and ask for a Delete my data request. We will honor it, and we will also ask the dealer to delete their copy — but we cannot delete a copy the dealer has already received and kept in their own systems.

Adults only

Moetiv is for people 18 and older. We do not knowingly collect children’s data, and if we learn we have, we will delete it.

Questions

Email us at privacy@motiv.app.

Terms of Service

Last updated: November 25, 2026

By using Moetiv, you agree to these terms. They’re written in plain language on purpose.

What Moetiv is — and isn’t

Moetiv is a vehicle discovery platform: it helps you find cars and, if you ask, reach out to a dealer. Moetiv is not a dealership, not a broker, and not a lender. We don’t own or sell the cars shown, and we don’t finance purchases.

Listings can change or be wrong

Prices, mileage, photos, and availability come from dealers and CarGurus listings. They can change at any time and can sometimes be wrong. Always verify the price, the car, and its availability with the dealer before you buy.

What Moe can and can’t do

Moe, the AI agent, can ask a dealer for their best out-the-door price, monthly payment, trade-in appraisal, and availability. Moe cannot guarantee a price, a reply from the dealer, a trade-in value, or that a car is still available. Any number a dealer sends back is the dealer’s offer, not Moetiv’s promise.

Your part

  • Give true information. Don’t use Moetiv to mislead a dealer.
  • You are responsible for the final deal: inspecting the car, test-driving it, reading and signing the paperwork, and paying.
  • Only send a deal when you’re genuinely interested in the car.

Provided as-is

Moetiv is provided “as is,” with no warranty of any kind. To the extent allowed by law, Moetiv’s liability is limited — we are not responsible for a dealer’s prices, replies, or conduct, or for any deal you do or don’t make.

The basics

New Jersey law governs these terms. Moetiv is for people 18 and older only. Questions: privacy@motiv.app.
